hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: How I handle your data — short, clear, and without the fine print.

policy.introduction: This Privacy Policy explains how I, PlaywithK, a sole proprietor based in Germany, process personal data when you visit this website or interact with my games (e.g., via Steam, itch.io). I'm a solo, independent developer and collect as little data as possible.

voluntary.title: 2.1 Information You Provide Voluntarily
voluntary.paragraph: If you contact me via the contact form or email, I collect:
voluntary.note: I use this only to respond to you — no mailing list, no marketing.

automatic.title: 2.2 Information Collected Automatically (Hosting)
automatic.paragraph: This site is hosted on Vercel. Visiting the site automatically processes technical information, including:
automatic.note: This data is used to deliver the site reliably and securely, and is handled according to Vercel's privacy policy.

cookies.title: 2.3 Cookies
cookies.paragraph: This site does not set marketing or tracking cookies. Any cookies used are strictly necessary for basic functionality.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
list: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — to respond to your inquiries
Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — legitimate interest in secure website operation

sharing.title: 4. Sharing of Information
sharing.paragraph: I do not sell your data. I share data only with:
list: Vercel, as my hosting provider, to the extent technically necessary

thirdPartyPlatforms.title: 5. Third-Party Platforms (Steam, itch.io)
thirdPartyPlatforms.paragraph: My games are distributed through third-party platforms. Your data is processed there under their own privacy policies:

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.paragraph: I retain correspondence only as long as necessary or required by law (e.g., German tax/commercial retention obligations of up to 6–10 years). Server logs are retained only as long as Vercel's default retention allows.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
list: Lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority
rights.contactNote: To exercise any of these rights, contact me at support@playwithk.de.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.paragraph: This site is not specifically directed at children under 16. I do not knowingly collect data from children.

internationalTransfers.title: 9. International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.paragraph: Where data is processed outside the EU (e.g., by Vercel in the US), this occurs only under an appropriate safeguard such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

externalLinks.title: 10. External Links
externalLinks.paragraph: This site may link to external sites. I am not responsible for their privacy practices.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.paragraph: I may update this policy occasionally. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance.
